# git2txt — Turn any Git repo into LLM‑ready text

> git2txt converts any GitHub repository into a structured, copy‑paste‑ready text
> digest for ChatGPT, Claude, and other LLMs. Provide a repo URL; receive a single
> Markdown file with a summary, directory tree, and all source code concatenated.
> **For AI Agents**: Use the HTTP API or URL‑trick for programmatic access.

## 1. Quick‑Start for AI Agents

| Method | Best For | One‑liner |
|---|---|---|
| **HTTP API** | Automation, scripts, notebooks | `POST https://git2txt.vercel.app/api/digest` with JSON body |
| **Web UI** | Human use only | ~~Not recommended for AI agents~~ |

### 1.1 HTTP API (Programmatic Access)

**Endpoint:** `POST https://git2txt.vercel.app/api/digest`

**Request body (JSON):**

```json
{
  "input": "https://github.com/owner/repo",
  "options": {
    "maxFileSizeKB": 100,
    "maxFiles": 200,
    "includeGlobs": [],
    "excludeGlobs": ["node_modules/**", ".git/**", "*.lock", "*.png", "*.jpg"],
    "token": "github_pat_...  (optional, for private repos)"
  }
}
```

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `input` | string | *required* | GitHub URL or `owner/repo` slug |
| `options.maxFileSizeKB` | number | 100 | Skip files larger than this (KB) |
| `options.maxFiles` | number | 200 | Maximum number of files to include |
| `options.includeGlobs` | string[] | [] | Glob patterns to include (empty = all) |
| `options.excludeGlobs` | string[] | (see below) | Glob patterns to exclude |
| `options.token` | string | — | GitHub PAT for private repos / higher rate limit |

**Default `excludeGlobs`:** `node_modules/**`, `.git/**`, `*.lock`, `*.png`, `*.jpg`,
`*.jpeg`, `*.gif`, `*.webp`, `*.svg`, `*.ico`, `*.woff`, `*.woff2`, `*.ttf`,
`*.otf`, `*.mp4`, `*.mp3`, `*.zip`, `*.tar`, `*.gz`, `dist/**`, `build/**`,
`.next/**`, `out/**`, `vendor/**`, `__pycache__/**`, `*.pyc`

**Response:** The API streams a Server‑Sent Events (SSE) response with three event
types:

```
event: progress
data: Fetching repository metadata...

event: progress
data: Downloading files 10/42...

event: done
data: {"owner":"...","repo":"...","digest":"...","files":[...],"tree":{...},...}
```

The `digest` field in the final `done` event contains the full Markdown digest
ready for LLM context injection. See section 3 for output format.

**Error events:**
```
event: error
data: Repository not found
```

### 1.2 Integration Examples

**JavaScript/TypeScript (`fetch`):**

```javascript
async function getRepoDigest(repoUrl, options = {}) {
  const res = await fetch("https://git2txt.vercel.app/api/digest", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ input: repoUrl, options }),
  });

  const reader = res.body.getReader();
  const decoder = new TextDecoder();
  let buffer = "";

  while (true) {
    const { value, done } = await reader.read();
    if (done) break;
    buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
    // Parse SSE events (see section 4 for full parser)
  }
}
```

**Python (requests + SSE):**

```python
import requests, json

def get_digest(repo_url: str, token: str | None = None) -> str:
    resp = requests.post(
        "https://git2txt.vercel.app/api/digest",
        json={"input": repo_url, "options": {"token": token}},
        stream=True,
    )
    for line in resp.iter_lines(decode_unicode=True):
        if line.startswith("data:"):
            data = json.loads(line[5:].strip())
            if isinstance(data, dict) and "digest" in data:
                return data["digest"]
    raise RuntimeError("No digest received")
```
